visual_accuracy.rationale: Lesson 1 actually renders the binary-search problem and array with the target/final element highlighted, whereas Lesson 2’s title screen is an erroneous OBS screen capture unrelated to the lesson despite its mid-frame correctly showing the index-8 comparison.

interactivity.rationale: Lesson 1 includes a well-formed, wired quiz gate with a real binary-search question, plausible answer options, and a marked correct answer after act_found, whereas Lesson 2 has no available gate specs or plan JSON and therefore no functional interactivity.

narration_quality.rationale: Lesson 1 has clear, well-paced narration with spoken math rendered naturally, while Lesson 2 has no transcript available and therefore provides no assessable narration.

sync.rationale: Lesson 1 provides timed cues that generally coincide with the narrated references to pointers, midpoint, elimination, final match, and complexity comparison, whereas Lesson 2 has no transcript or cue data at all, making its synchronization absent and impossible to verify.

concept_accuracy.rationale: Lesson 1 correctly traces binary search to index 7 and explains the halving/logarithmic rationale clearly, while Lesson 2 has no available transcript or script to demonstrate any accurate or pedagogically useful concept explanation.

polish.rationale: Lesson 1 is consistently composed, legible, and mostly clean despite minor overlap/raw-symbol issues, whereas Lesson 2 has a severely broken OBS recursive capture on the title screen plus visible browser chrome/cursor and excessive empty space in the lesson frame.

aggregator.explanation: All six dimension agents strongly favored Lesson 1, with consistently high confidence. Lesson 1 was judged superior in visual accuracy, interactivity, narration quality, synchronization, concept accuracy, and polish. The strongest issues for Lesson 2 were missing transcript/cue/plan data, no functional interactivity, and severe visual/polish problems including an erroneous OBS capture, while Lesson 1 presented a coherent binary-search lesson with correct tracing, synchronized cues, a working quiz gate, and clear narration.
